items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Is that when Rudolph got hurt?

ctx.x: Oh he played, he played a lot with us one night, you understand. We had some accident with our drum player. He got, he got, he got, I didn't, so. Howard, Howard came around and just there to get him, played the drums. It's alright.
Is that when Rudolph got hurt?
Yeah. It's time for, when we see cutting, Howard came up there and Howard brings the job up.
